rows.title: Press Release
rows.summary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 04, 2026, titled "Dr. Moopen family picks up additional stake in the Company".

rows.title: Copy of Newspaper Publication
rows.summary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding intimation of 18th Annual General Meeting scheduled for 28 September 2026

rows.title: Capacity addition
rows.summary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited has informed the Exchange regarding capacity expansion at the facility of a material subsidiary of the Company

rows.title: Amalgamation/Merger
rows.summary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Amalgamation of KIMSHEALTH Executive Leisure Private Limited with Spiceretreat Hospitality Services Private Limited, step-down subsidiaries of the Company
